items.title: President Will Signal Nuclear Aims Over If He Ends War, Says Former National Intelligence Official
items.original_title: President Will Signal Nuclear Aims Over If He Ends War, Says Former National Intelligence Official
items.rss_summary: Former Deputy Director of National Intelligence and Retired Lieutenant General Karen Gibson said that if the president declares war with Iran over it will signal he has abandoned the aims of the war, including putting curbs on the Iranian nuclear program. Gibson said that even if President Trump declares war over, it will likely not move Iran's blockade on the Strait of Hormuz unless the US is prepared to give up its economic campaign as well.  (Source: Bloomberg)

items.title: Vance: US probing airstrike that Iran says hit a wedding party
items.original_title: Vance: US probing airstrike that Iran says hit a wedding party
items.rss_summary: WASHINGTON, Sept 3 (Reuters) - U.S.Vice President JD Vance on Thursday said the United States is investigating anairstrike that Iran says struck a wedding party in Iran."We're investigating it because obviously we care. We want to know," Vance told reporters during a White House press briefing."If we do make mistakes, again, this is a big difference between us and Iran, when our military makes mistakes, they learn from them to try to get better from them," Vance added.

items.title: Ahead of elections, Israel tests West's patience on West Bank violence
items.original_title: Ahead of elections, Israel tests West's patience on West Bank violence
items.rss_summary:
Israel's ties with many Western allies were already fraught over its conduct in the Gaza war, but the worsening situation in the occupied West Bank has seen relations nosedive before close-fought October elections.  
            Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu's right-wing government is pushing ahead with the expansion of Israeli settlements, which are illegal under international law, while daily reports of settler attacks against Palestinians provoke international outrage.
